records.text: Soon people will not be able to make new humans, but that would be great because humans could be designed in a lab.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep ZzAT2xijKGQ)

appearances.snippet: soon people won't be able to make new humans anymore but I guess that would be la la land great because we can just design them in a lab

verification.notes: The quoted language appears in a 2012 email attributed to Norway's Crown Princess Mette-Marit in the DOJ Epstein files. Current reporting independently confirms the released email correspondence and its surrounding 'tickle my brain' language. This verifies that the prediction was written, not that it will come true.
